name: Green Thumb Industries Inc.
headline_status: Green Thumb is a Chicago-based cannabis brand maker and RISE dispensary owner operating in 14 U.S. states, growing revenue in 2026 while consolidating the hemp-beverage company RYTHM, Inc.
summary: Green Thumb Industries makes and sells branded cannabis products and runs the RISE Dispensaries chain. Its brands include RYTHM, Dogwalkers, incredibles, Beboe, &Shine and Good Green. The company has revenue in 14 states, ran 130 retail stores at the end of September 2026 and employs about 5,000 people. Third-quarter 2026 revenue rose 11.3% to $324.4 million, helped by Minnesota's adult-use market, which opened in September 2025, and by new stores, with Florida now its fastest-growing retail state. Comparable-store sales returned to growth for the first time since 2024, although price pressure continued in several markets. Green Thumb has a reputation for steady cash generation: it ended the quarter with $316 million in cash against $177 million of senior debt and renewed its share buyback in September 2026. From October 10, 2026 it began consolidating RYTHM, Inc., a public hemp and beverage company in which it holds notes and warrants. Looking ahead, management points to Virginia adult-use sales from July 2027, a conditional license in Texas, and DEA registrations for some medical dispensaries after the 2026 Schedule III change.

State-licensed medical marijuana moves to Schedule III federally; Green Thumb later receives DEA registrations for some medical licenses.
Signs amendment with RYTHM, Inc. removing ownership caps on its notes and warrants, setting up consolidation.
Board authorizes a new share repurchase program after the previous one expired.
Green Thumb becomes primary beneficiary of RYTHM, Inc. and begins consolidating it.
Reports Q3 2026 revenue of $324.4 million and the first comparable-sales growth since Q3 2024.

faq.q: What are Green Thumb's stock tickers?
faq.a: Green Thumb trades on the Canadian Securities Exchange as GTII and is quoted in the U.S. on the OTCQX as GTBIF.
RISE is Green Thumb's own retail chain. The company had 130 stores open across its 14 states at the end of September 2026, with Florida its fastest-expanding market.

faq.q: Which states does Green Thumb operate in?
faq.a: California, Connecticut, Florida, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island and Virginia. It also holds a conditional license in Texas.

faq.q: What is Green Thumb's link to RYTHM, Inc.?
faq.a: Green Thumb holds convertible notes, warrants and a services agreement with RYTHM, Inc., a separately listed company. After an August 2026 amendment removed ownership caps, Green Thumb started consolidating RYTHM in its financial statements from October 10, 2026.
On an adjusted basis it is: normalized EBITDA was $89.4 million in Q3 2026. Under GAAP it reported a small net loss of $4.8 million for the quarter, partly due to RYTHM brand licensing fees.
